upstream.archive_method: git archive of exact commit with LFS smudge/filter disabled; tracked LFS pointer contents retained. No git history or temporary research probe included.

original_contribution: A complete behavioral task contract, independent row-level and serialization verifier, and reference integration fixing selected-time recording export. The underlying upstream bug is public; no internal implementation is required by the contract.

sources.finding: Reporter supplies a frame-selection export reproducer; maintainer identifies whole-chunk export rather than truncation.
Same reporter confirms excess exported intervals in real data. One affected reporter, prevalence unknown.
Reporter workaround sets maximum chunk rows to one, then exports and optionally compacts.
Current to_messages checks chunk-range overlap but exports whole chunks; executable selected-range reproduction fails at the intended behavioral assertion.
Earlier fix keeps static chunks and improves overlap detection; row truncation is not implemented.
Existing deep chunk slicing primitives do not connect time selection to export.

public_solution_overlap.known: Bounded September 13 audit found no exact linked or named active implementation. Existing generic chunk filters make a compact repair possible.
public_solution_overlap.search_scope: Saved issue timeline, all 18 open PRs, 100 recently updated closed PRs, exact issue all-state PR search and broader time-selection/time-slice searches, plus relevant historical diffs.
public_solution_overlap.limit: Not an exhaustive search of every fork or private work. Source ledger is research/rust-package-review/sources/rerun-audit-sources.json.

horizon.difficulty_metadata: medium is a qualitative author estimate, not measured model difficulty
horizon.hypothesis: Requires tracing an existing chunk export boundary and preserving Arrow row alignment and serialization behavior. Suitable existing helpers may make this a modest repair.

runtime.override_reason: Use the available pinned multi-architecture Rust image and existing verified CPU reproduction cache; no source toolchain or dependency files changed.
runtime.profiles: dev optimization/debug=0; package wildcard optimization=0; two build jobs
runtime.locked_dependencies: upstream Cargo.lock; only target crate dependencies downloaded and built at image construction
runtime.isolation_limit: Submitted Rust remains executable code; this is protected verifier/data separation, not a malicious-code sandbox guarantee.
runtime.linker: LLVM lld via /usr/local/bin/cc wrapper; reduces Arrow/RRD link peak memory without source changes
